name: Increase Ground Item Label Cap to 128
description: Raises both synchronized ground-item label collections from 32 to 128 entries.

patches.description: Compare the label-record count with 128 using a 16-bit immediate
Move the 0x144-byte label-record truncation endpoint from 32 entries to 128 entries
Grow the label-record collection to 128 entries instead of 32
Enter layout-list normalization for source counts of 128 or more
Compare the current layout-list count with 128 using a 16-bit immediate
Stop growing the layout list when it reaches 128 entries
Stop shrinking the bounded layout list when it reaches 128 entries
